idp.scope: Three enclosures, four regional animal symbols, and tortoise/snake imagery.

moe-zi-shen.scope: Cites Shiji: Shen as White Tiger and Zi as the Tiger head; does not prescribe a modern illustration or a per-star anatomy.

astro92.title: 台北天文馆《台北星空》92期：谜样星宿
astro92.scope: Broad Vermilion Bird motifs: Willow/beak, Star/neck, Extended Net/crop, Wings/wings; no forced one-to-one star body mapping.

astro62.title: 台北天文馆《台北星空》62期
astro62.scope: Explains Wei as a celestial granary in traditional stellar lore, supporting a storage/granary motif rather than an invented pot.

astro34.title: 台北天文馆期刊34期：每月一星
astro34.scope: Explains Lou through gathering and Wei through receiving food; used only for a broad symbolic reading.
